hadith:
Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi) - Narrated Abu Qatada:

We set out with the Prophet (ﷺ) in the year of Al-Hudaibiya, and all his companions assumed the state of Ihram but I did not.
message: Allah, the Powerful (Al-Qaadir), created you from a humble beginning and ordained your complete development with infinite wisdom and strength. Just as the Prophet (peace be upon him) journeyed with full commitment in his endeavors, you too are called to move forward with faith in Allah's divine power and plan for your life. Trust that the One who fashioned you with such care has the complete capability to guide and sustain you through every stage of your journey.
name:
Al Qaadir - الْقَادِرُ - The Powerful

The name Al Qaadir is derived from the Arabic root 'q-d-r', which denotes strength and capability. This name reflects the belief that Allah has complete control over the universe and is capable of exercising His will in all matters. It emphasizes the concept of divine power and authority in Islamic theology.
verse:
'Abasa - He Frowned - 80:19

He created them from a sperm-drop, and ordained their development.
